Conversion

Choose the god your people will serve.

Players
World
Fog of war

Rules
Faith
Every building you raise carries your god’s sign. Turn a Church into a Temple, build an Altar in its ring to train faith troops, and research each one’s special attack. Raise the Veil to summon your champion.
Gather
Nothing gathers itself, and every tile gives just 1. Sowers do it all, but only inside your farm rings (7 squares around your Church, plus every Storehouse): Farm plants and reaps wheat, Forest chops and replants trees, and Mine opens up with research. They carry up to 3 at a time back to a Storehouse or Church before it counts. Goods in a Storehouse are taken by raiders if it falls. Wood and stone build; wheat trains.
Room
Your Church holds 5 troops. Every step adds 5 more: turning a Church into a Temple, or building another Church. Temples also open deeper research.
Research
Research never unlocks a unit or building, only an extra ability: Sower skills, mining and gathering speed, Warrior speed, Archer range, Storehouse size, faith troop powers and god-themed defenses. Each branch climbs in order; tier 2 needs one Temple, tier 3 needs two.
Storage
Your Church holds 30 of each resource, each extra Church 10 more and each Storehouse 20 more (more with research). Reapers can’t drop off once you’re full
Army
Churches train Sowers and Missionaries. Barracks (any time) train your faith’s frontline troop and Rams. An Altar (one per Temple, inside its ring) trains all three of your god’s faith troops, and the Veil (needs an Altar) summons your champion with souls.
Attack
Your rivals start in other corners of the same land. March your army to them and bring down their Church.
Expand
Build a Church anywhere that isn’t a rival’s land and it claims the land around it, with its own farm ring, storage and troop space. That’s how you grow.
